title: An ultra-Orthodox community in Israel has its own Hill

tellings.quote: golden and they live in an very Ultra Orthodox community in Israel they have their own Hill

plain: A family named Golden, including Arthur Golden and Ben Golden, live in a very ultra-Orthodox community in Israel and, as the story goes, 'have their own Hill'. Ky Dickens, maker of a documentary about children said to read minds, tells this on Michels' show, passing on what she was told.
